name: Toxic / fire

request.text: Single fictional spore rifle discharge. Immediate muffled pressure pop and dry papery organic crackle, fine powder spraying with a brief breathy hiss. Not liquid, not acid, not a monster voice. One compact trigger pull, no voice, no music, no echo.
